subject: Shiny Apps Greys out in the server but works well in local

messages.author: f148f7ce520639cc
messages.subject: Shiny Apps Greys out in the server but works well in local
parts:
Hi,

I built a simple Shiny Apps through RStudio and it works well in my local machine. But when I deployed to the server using the publish button from the console, it always greys out. I search around this issue but still can't figure it out.

Here is my setup:

I include my data loading step in the Helpers.R script and quote it in the server.R.The data contains the data I use in the app. I also use shinyapps::showLogs() and the log shows:

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading application bundle...DONE
Deploying application: 41146...
Waiting for task: 30818244
  building: Processing bundle: 180571
  building: Parsing manifest
  building: Building image: 176795
  building: Installing packages
  building: Installing files
  building: Pushing image: 176795
  deploying: Starting instances
  rollforward: Activating new instances
  terminating: Stopping old instances
Application successfully deployed to http://yidu.shinyapps.io/FHFA_HPI
ShinyApps deployment completed: http://yidu.shinyapps.io/FHFA_HPI

I am confused why my App works in the local machine but when deployed to shinyapps.io, the page is always grey.

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Shiny Apps Greys out in the server but works well in local
parts:
Hi Yi,
It looks like you are running with the default instance size.  Could you try bumping it up to an xlarge instance size and trying again?   I suspect your application is taking up more than 500MB of memory when it runs.
Best
-Tareef
